svg.title: Project 03: Multi-AZ Zero-Trust VPC with Gateway Endpoints & Observability
svg.text: Project 03 · Multi-AZ Zero-Trust VPC with Gateway Endpoints & Observability
Multi-AZ Subnets / VPC Gateway Endpoints ($0 NAT Tax) / S3 Zero-Trust Policy / VPC Flow Logs
Tier 1: Public Subnets (Attached to Internet Gateway 0.0.0.0/0)
Tier 2: Private Isolated Subnets (ZERO Route to Internet Gateway)
Tier 3: Observability as Code (VPC Flow Logs Telemetry)
Hardware sensor captures every IP packet: srcAddr -> dstAddr:port [action: ACCEPT/REJECT]
FinOps Retention Capping: 7 Days (Purges old logs)
Direct NoSQL access with sub-ms internal latency
• NAT Gateway Elimination: 20 TB monthly S3 transfer through NAT costs $965/mo. Gateway Endpoint = $0.00!
• Exfiltration Defense: Default endpoints allow traffic to ANY external S3 bucket. Our policy blocks all foreign buckets.
• Longest Prefix Match (LPM): Nitro hypervisor matches pl-s3 automatically without modifying instance code.
• REJECT Packet Detection: VPC Flow Logs capture dropped firewall packets without installing server agents.
• Retention Discipline: CloudWatch Log Group capped at 7 days to eliminate $0.03/GB compounding storage debt.
• STS Security Handshake: VPC Flow Log daemon assumes customer role strictly to write to defined log stream.
